run._comment: Run name, output folders and free-disk margin.
run.description: Evenly spaced motor grid over X +/-5500 and Y +/-15000 counts about the saved reference; one fresh Line1 camera pair per point
run.name: lab_motor_raster

output._comment: Lab PNG storage; raw16 keeps native counts before the configured crop/bin transforms.

png._comment: Lossless 256x256 uint16 images using existing crop/bin transforms; pairing is taken from committed capture IDs.

postprocess._comment: Capture-ID database finalization is mandatory. Existing data_analysis action is DMD-specific.

background._comment: Camera-only background capture count, timeout and output folder.

writer._comment: Apply camera settings once before listening. Capture queues and per-pair durability are controlled by the lab coordinator.

_cameras_comment: Active camera aliases, configured below in camera_setting.

camera_setting._comment: Laser reference check 2026-11-12: round integer exposures cam1 200ms / cam2 2ms, gain0, DMD off. Worst native maxima3449/3057 over three fresh pairs, zero saturation. Preserve live ROI (360,0,1216,1216). Matched-exposure backgrounds and per-camera DN/s normalization required for cross-source comparison; full-range safety still unverified. ROI config offsetX/offsetY are center coordinates968/608; FESA top-left remains360/0 with size1216x1216.

tap._comment: FESA capture mode, timing selectors and image-read checks.

sync._comment: Camera pairing source priority and allowed timestamp span/drift (nanoseconds).

scan._comment: Set nx and ny to choose the grid density over the fixed reference-relative rectangle: X -5500..+5500, Y -15000..+15000 raw counts. Both endpoints are included; evenly spaced targets are rounded to integer counts. At 100x100, X steps are 111/112 and Y steps are 303/304 counts.

capture._comment: Software selection from continuous external triggers. Guard is empirically tested; timing proxy does not prove simultaneous exposures.

motors._comment: Scan center is the saved reference, independent of the current live position. Raw controller counters; no homing, motion-parameter writes or reset. Return to LIVE preflight start only after successful collection.
